text:
Jeffrey Viel set up Sam O'Reilly's first NHL goal on Nov 17, a pass Sportsnet called beautiful, and that's the most anyone has written about his offense this season. He's a 29-year-old undrafted energy forward on his fourth NHL team, playing ten minutes a night for Tampa and throwing hits (59 in 19 games). Markerzone reported he was part of a fight-filled night against Columbus on Nov 12.

No goals on 1.5 expected and three assists. The on-ice numbers are rough: Tampa gets 47% of the expected goals with him on at five on five, 11 points worse than without him. Evolving-Hockey had a similar note last season.

There's a bit more to his game than the hits. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at the 85th percentile for chances from in front of the net last season, and 18% of his setups came from behind the goal line. NHL Edge puts his top speed at the 94th percentile.

The Lightning have won seven of his last ten games. What to watch: whether he holds the fourth-line spot as Tampa gets healthy.
